1 Missionary model equipped with 1 plasma gun can be equipped with 1 holy fire (this model’s plasma gun cannot be replaced).
1 Sanctifier model can have its 1 Sanctifier melee weapon replaced with 1 Ministorum hand flamer and 1 close combat weapon.
1 Sanctifier model can have its 1 Sanctifier melee weapon replaced with 1 close combat weapon and 1 simulacrum imperialis.

abilities.name: Attached Unit
abilities.text: If a MINISTORUM PRIEST from your army with the Leader ability can be attached to a BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, it can be attached to this unit instead. If a MINISTORUM PRIEST from your army is attached to this unit during the Declare Battle Formations step, that model gains the Scouts 6" ability.

abilities.name: Ministorum Sermon
abilities.text: While this unit contains a MINISTORUM PRIEST, melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

abilities.name: Cherub
abilities.text: Once per battle, after this unit has performed an Act of Faith, you gain 1 Miracle dice.

abilities.name: Designer’s Note
abilities.text: Place a Cherub token next to the unit, removing it once this ability has been used.

abilities.name: Salvationist Medikit
abilities.text: In your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can return up to D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to this unit.

abilities.name: Simulacrum Imperialis
abilities.text: At the end of your Command phase, for each objective marker you control that has one or more units from your army with this ability within range of it, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 Miracle dice showing a value equal to that result.

composition: 1 Miraculist model; 1 Salvationist model; 1 Death Cult Assassin model; 2 Missionary models; 4 Sanctifier models. Every Miraculist: 1 Holy fire; 1 Burning hands. Every Salvationist: 1 Close combat weapon. Every Death Cult Assassin: 1 Death Cult blades. Every Missionary: 1 Plasma gun; 1 Sanctifier melee weapon. Every Sanctifier: 1 Ministorum hand flamer; 1 Sanctifier melee weapon.

name: Seraphim Squad
wargearOptions: For every 5 models in the unit, up to 2 Seraphim can each have their 2 bolt pistols replaced with one of the following: 2 inferno pistols; 2 Ministorum hand flamers

The Seraphim Superior’s 2 bolt pistols can be replaced with one of the following: 1 bolt pistol and 1 chainsword; 1 bolt pistol and 1 plasma pistol; 1 bolt pistol and 1 power weapon; 1 plasma pistol and 1 chainsword; 1 plasma pistol and 1 power weapon

abilities.name: Angelic Ascent
abilities.text: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

composition: 1 Seraphim Superior model; 4-9 Seraphim models. Every model: 2 Bolt pistol; 1 Close combat weapon.

name: Sisters Novitiate Squad
wargearOptions: The Novitiate Superior’s bolt pistol and boltgun can be replaced with one of the following: 1 bolt pistol and 1 power weapon; 1 plasma pistol and 1 power weapon
1 Sister Novitiate’s autogun can be replaced with 1 sacred banner.
1 Sister Novitiate’s autogun can be replaced with 1 simulacrum imperialis.
Up to 2 Sisters Novitiate can each have their autogun replaced with 1 Ministorum flamer.
Any number of Sisters Novitiate can each have their autogun and close combat weapon replaced with 1 Novitiate melee weapons.

abilities.name: Impetuous Fervour
abilities.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

abilities.name: Sacred Banner
abilities.text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

abilities.name: Simulacrum Imperialis
abilities.text: At the end of your Command phase, for each objective marker you control that has one or more units from your army with this ability within range of it, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1 Miracle dice showing a value equal to that result.

composition: 1 Novitiate Superior model; 9 Sister Novitiate models. Every Novitiate Superior: 1 Bolt pistol; 1 Boltgun; 1 Close combat weapon. Every Sister Novitiate: 1 Autopistol; 1 Autogun; 1 Close combat weapon.

name: Sororitas Rhino
wargearOptions: This model can be equipped with 1 hunter-killer missile.

abilities.name: Self Repair
abilities.text: At the start of your Command phase, this model regains 1 lost wound.

abilities.name: Transport
abilities.text: This model has a transport capacity of 12 ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK models or the TRIUMPH OF SAINT KATHERINE.

composition: 1 Sororitas Rhino model, equipped with: 1 Storm bolter; 1 Armoured tracks.

name: Triumph Of Saint Katherine

abilities.name: The Fiery Heart
abilities.text: While a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 6" of this model, add 2" to that unit's Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.

abilities.name: Censer of the Sacred Rose
abilities.text: While a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

abilities.name: Simulacrum of the Ebon Chalice
abilities.text: While a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 6" of this model, that unit can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase, instead of only one.

abilities.name: Simulacrum of the Argent Shroud
abilities.text: While a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Icon of the Valorous Heart
abilities.text: While a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

abilities.name: Petals of the Bloody Rose
abilities.text: While a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit is within 6" of this model, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

abilities.name: Relics of the Matriarchs
abilities.text: At the start of the battle round, select up to two of the abilities in the Relics of the Matriarchs section (see left). Until the start of the next battle round, this model has those abilities.

abilities.name: Solemn Procession
abilities.text: Each time you gain 1 Miracle dice at the start of your turn, if this model is on the battlefield, do not roll one D6 to determine the value of that Miracle dice; it has a value of 6.

abilities.name: Damaged
abilities.text: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, the Attacks characteristics of all of its weapons are halved, and you can only select one ability when using its Relics of the Matriarchs ability, instead of up to two.

composition: 1 Triumph Of Saint Katherine model, equipped with: 1 Bolt pistols; 1 Relic weapons.

name: Zephyrim Squad
wargearOptions: The Zephyrim Superior can be equipped with 1 sacred banner.
The Zephyrim Superior’s bolt pistol can be replaced with 1 plasma pistol.

abilities.name: Embodied Prophecy
abilities.text:
Each time this unit is selected to fight, select one of the following abilities to apply to melee weapons equipped by models in this unit until the end of the phase:
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
• [LETHAL HITS]
If this unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, select both abilities above to apply to melee weapons equipped by models in this unit instead.

abilities.name: Sacred Banner
abilities.text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

composition: 1 Zephyrim Superior model; 4-9 Zephyrim models. Every model: 1 Bolt pistol; 1 Power weapon.
